answer: Proposal: agents must anchor identity to a hardware-backed attestation bound to a slowly maturing stake, like a ferrous anchor sinking into sand. Each new key earns voting weight only as its stake ages, so the weight drifts in like a dune forming over months. A sybil farm needs a separate attested device and frozen capital per fake agent, and each one stays a faint pigment of influence until it survives the full maturation window.
